FIG. 1 is a cross-sectional view schematically illustrating the separator of the present disclosure, which includes the elements described above. In the separator 10 illustrated in FIG. 1 , the porous organic-inorganic coating layer is formed on the porous substrate 1 and includes the inorganic particles 3 and the first binder polymer 5 . The organic coating layer 7 is formed by dispersing the second binder polymer on the surface of the organic-inorganic coating layer, leaving scattered uncoated areas.
